properties.headline: 77.3% occupied; $200M loan matures April
properties.notes: Occupancy 77.29%, expected near 79% within 60 days after application cleanup; confirmed down units fell from 35 to 12-13, with capital costs now tracked weekly on a make-ready board. Pick the path (bond recap, phased sale or extension) by mid-October so the 2027 budget and lender package are built on it, and close the RPM regional hire before the lender asks who runs the asset.

recommendations.title: Standardize the delinquency playbook from Upland across Mike's assets

recommendations.detail: The premium data (27 of 29 renovated units leased at $236-$270 premiums) is the strongest value-creation evidence in the portfolio. Send the $350K capital call separately from the default notice so the legal track does not delay renovations.

recommendations.title: Replace Newmark self-reporting with evidence-first closeout
